messages:
alex: Quick heads up — PR #7890 is blocking the hotpatch cutover and needs dual sign-off before the 22:00 UTC cutoff. Risk is the kv-cache regen edge-case we saw in staging. Pinging @maria @sam for reviews. CI flaky test fixed on rerun but want two independent LGTM so we can merge and start canary.

maria: On it, I'll do a quick security skim and verify the changelog. Do we have a rollback plan if canary shows regressions?

alex: Rollback plan is the usual: revert PR and scale down canary; ops runbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/hotpatchs — if canary >0.5% error rate we rollback. Confirmed.

sam: I'll take a look now. If CI is green after a clean rerun I'm happy to give an LGTM. @ci-bot can you rerun tests?

ci-bot: CI status for PR #7890 — initial: 1 failing (test_kv_cache_flake). Rerun triggered by @sam. Rerun result: all checks passed ✅ (build: 332, coverage unchanged).

luis: Quick Q — what's the canary window and traffic %? Need to ensure Dedicated pool isn't overloaded during regen.

alex: Canary will be 15 minutes, 5% traffic, then 30m at 20% if healthy. I'll attach the rollout plan to the PR.

jen: Please add the hotfix label and a short changelog entry (one-liner) before merging. Also make sure the release notes template has the kv-cache note. :memo:

sam: Reviewed the diff, comments addressed. LGTM.

maria: Security skim complete, no secrets exposed. LGTM.

luis: Gave a second LGTM after checking capacity and autoscale thresholds. Recommend close monitoring for the first 5 minutes.

alex: Awesome — merging after waiting the 2-minute merge-hold for CI flakiness window. Merge command I used:
```
./scripts/merge-pr --id 7890 --hold 120 --notify ops
```

sam: :thumbsup: I'll watch logs and post a quick health snapshot at +2m and +15m.

jen: Changelog added and label=hotfix. Notifying release-announce channel after canary.

alex: Thanks all — proceeding to merge in 60s. If anything odd, ping here and we'll roll back. :rocket:
